title: An Artinian ring has finite length over itself
statement: Let $B$ be an Artinian commutative ring, meaning that every descending chain of ideals eventually stabilizes. Regard $B$ as a module over itself. Define the module length of an $R$-module $M$ to be the supremum of the numbers of proper inclusions in strict chains of $R$-submodules (Stacks Tags 02LY and 00IV). Then the length of $B$ as a $B$-module is finite: there is an integer $N\ge0$ bounding the numbers of proper inclusions in all such chains.
